title: Corridor H: Davis to Parsons
subtitle: A pixel-art test drive through the Allegheny Mountains
intro: Here's a short test drive on Corridor H, through the mountains of West Virginia.
outro: And that's Parsons. Fifteen miles of mountain road, in eight bits.

holds.text: From the end of the four-lane at Davis, turn right and climb a couple of miles to Thomas.

holds.card: Thomas to Parsons, down the Seneca Trail
holds.text: Then take US two nineteen, the Seneca Trail, winding down the valley to Parsons.
